tip: Do not pay anyone who claims they can "process" or speed up your NELFUND application for a fee.
Do not pay for a NELFUND guarantor, or pay anyone claiming to provide one.
Never share your passwords, PINs, or OTPs (one-time passcodes) with anyone, including people claiming to be NELFUND or bank staff.
Do not trust application deadlines or opening dates shared on social media or by unofficial websites — confirm them on the official NELFUND portal.
Always verify important information through official NELFUND or your institution's channels before acting on it.
Never enter your NIN, BVN, bank details, or login credentials into a link sent to you unexpectedly — go directly to the official portal instead.
